info.name: SOLGASES API
info.description:
Backend API for catalog, inventory and user/role/permission administration

Generated from the OpenAPI specification by docs/postman/generate_postman_collection.py. Do not edit by hand.

request.description:
Authenticates an active internal user with username and password. Unknown users, wrong passwords and inactive users get the same 401 response.
Responses:
- 200: Access token issued
- 400: Invalid request body
- 401: Invalid username or password
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

Returns all categories, both active and inactive. No filtering, sorting or pagination is applied.
Responses:
- 200: List of categories
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

Creates a new category. It is always created active. The id is generated by the server.
Responses:
- 201: Category created
- 400: Invalid request body (blank name, name longer than 100 characters or malformed JSON)
- 409: A category with the same name already exists
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

Responses:
- 200: Category found
- 400: The id is not a valid number
- 404: Category not found
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

Replaces the editable data of the category (its name). The active flag is not modified; use the activate and deactivate operations for that.
Responses:
- 200: Category updated
- 400: Invalid id or request body
- 404: Category not found
- 409: Another category already uses the same name
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

Marks the category as active. Idempotent: if it is already active, the current state is returned.
Responses:
- 200: Category is active
- 400: The id is not a valid number
- 404: Category not found
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

Marks the category as inactive. Idempotent: if it is already inactive, the current state is returned. Categories are never deleted.
Responses:
- 200: Category is inactive
- 400: The id is not a valid number
- 404: Category not found
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

item.name: Get the current stock of a product

request.description:
Returns 0 if the product has no inventory movement yet; no record is created by this call.
Responses:
- 200: Current stock
- 400: The product id is not a valid number
- 404: Product not found
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

Increases or decreases the current stock according to direction. A DECREASE adjustment is rejected if it would leave the stock negative.
Responses:
- 201: Adjustment registered
- 400: Invalid request body
- 404: Product not found
- 409: The product is not active, the stock is insufficient, or a concurrent update was detected
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

Increases the current stock. Creates the Inventory row if this is the product's first movement.
Responses:
- 201: Entry registered
- 400: Invalid request body
- 404: Product not found
- 409: The product is not active, or a concurrent update was detected
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

Decreases the current stock. Rejected if it would leave the stock negative.
Responses:
- 201: Exit registered
- 400: Invalid request body
- 404: Product not found
- 409: The product is not active, the stock is insufficient, or a concurrent update was detected
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

item.name: List the inventory movements of a product

request.description:

query.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the product name

request.description:
Returns products matching the given optional, combinable filters. With no filters, returns every product, active and inactive. No pagination or sorting is applied.
Responses:
- 200: List of products
- 400: A filter value has an invalid format
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details

Creates a new product. It is always created active. The id is generated by the server. The referenced category and unit of measure must exist and be active.
Responses:
- 201: Product created
- 400: Invalid request body
- 404: The referenced category or unit of measure does not exist
- 409: A product with the same SKU already exists, or the referenced category or unit of measure is inactive
- 401: Missing, invalid or expired access token, or inactive user
- 403: The user does not have the permission required by this operation
- 500: Unexpected error. The response does not include internal details
